title: Measuring Fairness in Large Audio Language Models via Semantic-Aware Bias Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.13624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have seen increasing use for audio understanding tasks such as speech recognition and audio question answering, raising concerns about fairness across demographic subgroups. Fairness evaluation in spoken-input settings is challenging due to confounding factors, including semantic variation in spoken content and speaker-specific characteristics. Ignoring these factors can result in misleading conclusions about model bias. We propose a semantic-aware mixed-effects regression framework for fairness evaluation in LALMs that explicitly accounts for these confounders. Our approach incorporates sentence-level semantic embeddings of reference text as covariates and models speaker identity as a random effect. Notably, semantic representations are extracted from the same LALM under evaluation, enabling semantic control over variation as perceived by the model itself. translated_title: 大型音频语言模型中的公平性测量：基于语义感知的偏差估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13624v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在语音识别和音频问答等音频理解任务中的应用日益增多，这引发了对不同人口统计子群体间公平性的担忧。在语音输入场景中，公平性评估因混淆因素（包括语音内容的语义变化和说话者特定特征）而具有挑战性。忽视这些因素可能导致关于模型偏见的误导性结论。我们提出了一种语义感知的混合效应回归框架，用于LALMs中的公平性评估，该框架显式地考虑了这些混淆因素。我们的方法将参考文本的句子级语义嵌入作为协变量，并将说话者身份建模为随机效应。值得注意的是，语义表示是从被评估的同一LALM中提取的，从而能够对模型自身感知到的变化进行语义控制。在模拟数据和真实世界数据上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种语义感知的混合效应回归框架，通过利用被评估LALM自身的语义嵌入来控制内容变化和说话者身份，从而更准确地测量大型音频语言模型中的公平性偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a semantic-aware mixed-effects regression framework that leverages the LALM's own semantic embeddings to control for content variation and speaker identity, enabling more accurate fairness bias estimation in large audio language models.
